headline: A beach beneath a bridge. And that's just the start.
dek: Six memorable corners of the Amalfi Coast
editorial_intent: Reframe the Amalfi carousel around a surprising cove under a coastal bridge, backed by five real and varied high-quality coast experiences including lesser-known Atrani and sunset Amalfi.
reader_scenario: A traveller browsing an inspiring Italy photo gallery, who can manually swipe beautiful scenes and save the real place names.
share_reason: A dramatic bridge-over-cove first image makes the premise memorable, while carefully chosen distinct villas, mountain paths, cliff towns and evening harbour scenes offer a stronger six-stop save list.
slide_count_rationale: Six real 4:5 licensed photos: Fiordo di Furore hero; Ravello gardens; Path of the Gods viewpoint; Positano hillside; Atrani village; Amalfi historic town at sunset. No end-card filler.
caption:
There’s a beach tucked beneath a road bridge on Italy’s Amalfi Coast — and it’s only one of the places worth seeing. 🍋

📍 Fiordo di Furore — a turquoise cove framed by cliffs and an arched bridge.
📍 Ravello — garden terraces perched high above the coastline.
📍 Path of the Gods — an unforgettable hillside view towards Positano.
📍 Positano — tightly packed pastel houses above the sea.
📍 Atrani — a small seaside village squeezed between cliffs.
📍 Amalfi — a historic hillside town in the evening light.

Which would you go to first? Save this for a future Italian escape.

Photos: Rolands Varsbergs, nella n., Sekwang Chia, Ian Mackey & Ricardo Gomez Angel / Unsplash; Ahmet Yüksek / Pexels.
